name: Rozen Maiden: Duellwalzer
original_name: ローゼンメイデン ドゥエルヴァルツァ
source:
In the 20th century a legendary doll maker named Rozen created seven dolls powered with gems called Rosa Mystica. 

Since then Rozen sent dolls away to find masters and battle among themselves to gather each other's Rosa Mysticas; this competition is referred to as Alice Game. 

Only winner can become perfect Alice doll and reunite with Rozen.

The purpose of the game is to increase trust with one of dolls through events and win Alice Game together.

[Edited from [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/psx2/games2/TCPS-10153.html]Psxdatacenter[/url]]
translation:
20世纪，一位名叫罗真的传奇人偶师，制作了七个人偶，以名为“蔷薇圣母”的宝石赋予它们力量。

此后，罗真将人偶们送往各处，让它们寻找主人，并通过相互战斗，夺取彼此的蔷薇圣母。这场竞争被称为“爱丽丝游戏”。

只有胜者才能成为完美的爱丽丝人偶，再次与罗真相见。

玩家需要通过各种事件，加深与其中一个人偶的信任，并一同赢得爱丽丝游戏。

（根据[url=https://psxdatacenter.com/psx2/games2/TCPS-10153.html]Psxdatacenter[/url]编辑。）
